repairs: Sparse conversion builtin-type lookups and Domain attribute hooks now preserve real callbacks; both independently frozen followups are included.

First full gate found57 PolyMatrix native-route assertion failures after official units imports changed CoreExpr __str__/__repr__. Ground arithmetic does not consume those methods. Exclusion is limited to those two slots/functions; both keys must remain present so deletion cannot hide another hook at equal dictionary size.44 new tests cover counters/errors, imports, true printing errors, preserved arithmetic/attribute refusals and balanced-key forgery. Existing57 assertions retained.
remaining_gaps: Global mathematical parity is not certified.

Native rational driver handles admitted closed QQ/ZZ expression/tuple inputs, real None/True and certified linear/quadratic logarithmic groups. General RootSum, higher-degree groups, real False, other domains/options/protocols and budget refusal retain the complete old public driver. Broad Risch/PRDE/ODE drivers remain Python.

Sparse Berkowitz retains an actual legacy cold prefix until conversion makes the stock protocol provable; a deeply decoupled cold recursion may still perform old arithmetic before native continuation. No first-call/all-sparse-algorithms claim.
AUTO statistics and decisions are native for audited stock ZZ/QQ; remaining preparation and sparse GJ elimination are subsequent ports.
LLL, exact DomainElement floor/ceil and native rational protocol-state verification belong to later private stages and are not part of this release.
Other previously documented symbolic derivative, precision/domain/completeness and integration gaps remain open.

performance.status: Integrated AUTO public warm calls measured with exact certificates and same-binary control; small-case overhead retained. Other speed claims keep their separate identified packages.
